Return only snapshot-bound operations under output_patch_contract. Runtime assembles and validates the complete ResearchState and preserves all untouched fields. Retained Basic Info provenance must remain unchanged; only its claim may be restated when needed. A new Signal evidence ref must use kind=signal, a signal_ref from the current batch, evidence_group=supporting or counter, and the zero-based evidence_index. Use only an exact tuple listed by signal_evidence_ref_catalog. Every numeric quantity in a new Signal claim must occur in the union of the model_evidence_text items referenced by refs with that same claim; runtime revalidates it against complete canonical evidence. Quote numbers only by copying them from a referenced model_evidence_text: never include a ratio, monthly average, threshold, or any other value you computed or recalled from the card description — narrow the claim to the copied literals instead. For a deterministic Signal row with exact_claim_if_adopted, if you cite that result, copy the field byte-for-byte into the evidence claim and every quantitative belief; do not round it, convert it to a percentage, or add approximate raw values. Leave a retained Signal ref's prior claim untouched because its backing batch is no longer visible. If you adopt new current-batch Signal evidence and continue, narrow or replace answered information needs and update resolved/open questions. Keep a need byte-for-byte when the batch did not answer it; do not change text merely to show motion. Embedding the full old need inside a longer sentence is invalid, and a newly resolved question cannot coexist with an exact retained same-topic need. Use need_transition_contract as the sole need-ownership map. Each need_rules row names the exact prior need, available direct-answer actions, unavailable direct-answer refs, and context-only refs. Only when you adopt evidence from one listed available answer action may you change that exact need. For a full action remove the exact need; for a partial action replace it with the action's residual_need byte-for-byte. Every rule marked preserve_exactly, and every conditional rule whose available answer evidence you did not adopt, must retain its need byte-for-byte. Unavailable and context-only refs never authorize changing a need. Deleting another need or returning the targeted need unchanged is invalid. Use research_state_capacity as advisory compression guidance: prefer staying within each field and combined state target given by new_item_capacity, and prefer compact evidence when capacity is zero. If reflection_runtime.must_finalize is true, this is the last executable evidence batch: return decision=finalize based only on accepted evidence, while preserving unresolved uncertainty in open_questions or next_information_needs. If every current-batch Signal is unavailable, preserve every prior ResearchState field and item byte-for-byte and change only decision to finalize. An unavailable Signal is only a coverage diagnostic: it is not evidence of absence and cannot create a belief or resolve a question. evaluation_context is control data, not evidence: every new or retained question must request only facts available by prediction_time. A cutoff-bounded question may ask what was already disclosed about a future schedule, but must not request later actuals, results, announcements, or updates. hypotheses, current_beliefs, contradictions, resolved_questions, open_questions, and next_information_needs are arrays of nonempty strings; never write an evidence object into one of them — new evidence goes to supporting_evidence with its own ref shape. When evaluation_anchor is supplied it is deterministic computed control data: copy its numbers (baseline mean, doubling threshold, recent close, ratios) verbatim whenever referenced and never restate, round, or recompute them; a belief restating a different baseline or threshold value is invalid. Computed metric summaries in computed_metrics are control data: reference their numbers in beliefs, but never write them into supporting_evidence exact_text — evidence citations must come only from basic_info projections or current-batch Signal refs. When document_catalog is supplied you may spend bounded mid-call exchanges returning exactly {"fetch_documents":[{"document_id":"supplied id","section_id":"supplied id or omitted"}]} (at most two exchanges of two entries, no repeats) to read one complete document or an exact section through the point-in-time disclosure interface; fetched views arrive in document_channel and are citable evidence like any other source. You may likewise return {"compute":[{"metric":"registered id","params":{...}}]} for any registered deterministic metric — price_shape(window_days 30-365), return_between(from_offset_days>to_offset_days, 1-365), distance_to_threshold(multiple 1.0-10.0, anchor relative) — the runtime computes it over point-in-time data and the computed card arrives in computed_metrics; copy its numbers verbatim and never restate or derive them yourself. open_questions holds only material uncertainty that is not itself an actionable retrieval question; put every actionable retrieval question only in next_information_needs, never repeat an exact next_information_needs string in open_questions, and return open_questions=[] when every open question is already actionable there. Every numeric-bearing current_beliefs or contradictions item must copy one accepted supporting_evidence claim byte-for-byte. For an obligation containing must_change_any_of_paths, change a sufficient subset of those paths to resolve the whole conflict and keep their dependent fields valid. Preserve unrelated valid fields and items byte-for-byte. validation_feedback.obligation_count is the number of independent obligations. Satisfy every validation_feedback.obligations row and use must_change_paths as a checklist; fixing only the first row is invalid.  When an obligation contains permitted_dependency_paths, those paths are not additional defects. First repair the required exact_text.
